system.description:
You draw a picture of two Oni, Demons of your description. Infusing chakra into it as it exits your scroll and standing next to you.

You summon two construct Ink Oni’s. The Ink Oni’s has the following Statistics using your Ninjutsu attack bonus and Save DC for anything that requires an attack or saving throw;

You may command both Ink Oni’s as a bonus action on your turn. Each Ink Oni may be commanded to perform different actions. The Ink Oni’s may take an appropriate bonus actions or reactions if able.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of Oni’s you summon by +1.
